strapiBlog.title: LEOS Developments Launches Its First Master Community in Dubai Worth AED 5 Billion
strapiBlog.short_description: Wasl Group has taken a major step in expanding its presence beyond Dubai with the acquisition of a premium beachfront plot at Marjan Beach, Al Marjan Island.

data.text:
LEOS Developments has revealed plans for its first large-scale residential community in Dubai, marking a significant milestone in the company’s regional growth. 

The development, located in Wadi Al Safa 5 within Dubailand, will be a purpose-built wellness community offering residents an immersive lifestyle shaped by sustainability and design-led living.

Community Highlights

Planned as a lush, pedestrian-friendly district, this Dubai real estate project, valued at AED 5 billion, will feature thousands of trees, landscaped gardens, and serene water bodies to promote well-being and community interaction. Homes will be surrounded by open spaces and lifestyle amenities such as

  • Sports and recreation courts
  • Yoga and fitness studios
  • Outdoor gyms and cycling tracks
  • Play areas for children
  • Swimming pools and social hubs
  • Community retail and dining zones

Dubailand’s new residential master plan 2025 is designed to foster an active and balanced way of life, supporting residents’ physical and mental wellness.

data.text:
Regent’s Park - The First Chapter

The first phase, named Regent’s Park, will feature a mix of 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses, as well as larger villas with 5 to 7 bedrooms. More than 800 homes will be delivered in this opening stage, with a design focus on open layouts, natural light, and efficient energy use.

The new community represents LEOS Developments’ commitment to building neighbourhoods that prioritise quality of life, health, and environmental awareness. 

Conceived as part of Dubai’s ongoing urban evolution, the project will integrate modern planning principles with abundant green spaces, water features, and leisure amenities. 

Its design aligns closely with Dubai’s 2040 Urban Master Plan, which envisions sustainable growth and improved liveability across the city.

Smart home systems and EV-ready garages will be standard features, reflecting LEOS Developments’ focus on sustainable technologies. 

The project supports both the UAE Net Zero 2050 Strategy and the Dubai Clean Energy Strategy 2050, ensuring that residents live in a community ready for the future of energy-efficient living.

The Broader Impact

As Dubai continues to attract global investors and families seeking holistic living environments, LEOS Developments’ AED 5 billion master community positions the developer among the city’s renowned names, shaping wellness-focused communities.

It also signals growing confidence in Dubai’s long-term real estate outlook, where design, technology, and sustainability are increasingly seen as key drivers of value.

faqs.question: Where is the Regent’s Park located?

data.answer: It is situated in Wadi Al Safa 5, within Dubailand.

faqs.question: What is included in the first phase of the large-scale residential community??

data.answer: The first release, called Regent’s Park, will offer over 800 homes, including three- to seven-bedroom townhouses and villas.

faqs.question: What kind of amenities will be available?

data.answer: Residents will have access to sports facilities, yoga and fitness studios, cycling tracks, outdoor gyms, children’s play zones, swimming pools, and a clubhouse, among other amenities.
